Account Executive, SaaS, Bengaluru. You will manage the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing, run demos, negotiate contracts and keep the CRM current in Salesforce. We look for 2 to 4 years of B2B sales experience, strong communication, forecasting discipline and the ability to work with marketing on outbound campaigns. Experience selling to SMB and mid-market customers, handling objections, and meeting quarterly quota is expected. Knowledge of HubSpot is a plus. You will collaborate with customer success on renewals and share market feedback with the product team. A target driven, honest and curious approach to customers matters most.
Our stack: Salesforce and HubSpot for the pipeline, Marketo for Email Marketing and Lead Scoring, and Demand Generation campaigns run with marketing. You will also partner with Revenue Operations on forecasts.
